def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                color = grid[r][c]
                stack = [(r,c)]
                seen.add((r,c))
                cells = []
                while stack:
                    y,x = stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
                c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
                shape={(y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in cells}
                objs.append((c0,r0,color,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1,shape))
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:o[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if not objs: return out
    positions=[]
    y=x=0
    for i,(origx,origy,color,oh,ow,shape) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            py,px,ph,pw=positions[-1]
            # In the two-small-square lead-in, separate the first pair at the edge.
            if i==1 and ph==pw==oh==ow==2:
                y,x=py+ph,px+pw//2
            else:
                y,x=py+ph-1,px+pw-1
        positions.append((y,x,oh,ow))
        for dy,dx in shape:
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: out[yy][xx]=color
    return out
PY
